title: I Followed the Urgent-Lab Wristband After They Called My Draw a Walk-In

parts.text: I had a 10:20 draw and at 10:18 they called me a walk-in and sat a cash patient. The kiosk said: WRISTBAND TIME IS THE DRAW. I was thirty-nine, fasting, holding a band that still said 10:20. Tech Lila shrugged. I photographed the band, the kiosk, and the cash clip. Lila called it a flow. Flow is a word clips use when a time exists. I followed the band to the charge nurse. The draw happened at 10:20. Lila flows after appointments. The chair finally looks like a kiosk, not a register. The room sounds like a room again, not a title.

social.video_title: They called a 10:20 wristband a walk-in — Part 1/1
social.description: Fasting, a cash clip, a charge-nurse still. Has flow ever skipped a band?
